## Purpose
`src/lib/types/**` holds pure TypeScript mirrors of Rust `serde` DTOs — no React, no fetch calls, just types plus the small pure helpers a consumer needs to build/format them. Each file names, at its top, one or more discriminant unions whose variant tag is a `kind` field (or a sibling `Kind`/`Status` string enum) matching a Rust `#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]` enum byte-for-byte. The three exemplars (`economy.ts`, `specs.ts`, `trace.ts`) all open with a comment naming the exact Rust struct/module they mirror and the wave/spec that introduced the shape, so a future reader can find the source of truth instead of guessing at drift.

## Convention
Folder: apps/dashboard/src/lib/types/** · Extension: .ts · Files of this role in this subproject: 3
Field names stay snake_case to match the wire payload directly — no camelCase remapping inside these files (that remapping, when needed, happens one layer up in `lib/*.ts` wrappers, e.g. `ArtifactDrift` in `projects.ts`). A `kind` discriminant is a plain string literal union tagged internally (`{ kind: "project"; project: string } | ...`), never a TS `enum`. Every field and type gets a `/**` or `//` doc comment explaining WHY, not just what, especially for optional fields (backwards-compatibility rollout) and unit fields (micro-USD, permille, epoch-ms). Small pure constructor/helper functions (`projectScope`, `formatUsd`) may live at the bottom of the same file, grouped under a `// ── Section ──` banner comment, so callers never hand-build the discriminated literal themselves.

## How to apply
A new "kind" mirror gets its own top-level `export type Xxx = { kind: "..."; ... } | ...;` (or a plain string union when there is only one discriminant field) at the top of a `lib/types/*.ts` file — either an existing topical file (economy, specs, trace) or a new one named after the Rust module it mirrors. Add a doc comment above it naming the exact Rust struct/enum and the file it lives in, plus the spec/wave that introduced it. Re-export the new type from `lib/dashboard.ts` (or the relevant thin wrapper) via `export type { Xxx } from "@/lib/types/foo"` — do not import the type file directly from a page or component.

## Examples
Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/types/economy.ts
```ts
export type EconomyScope =
  | { kind: "project"; project: string }
  | { kind: "spec"; project: string; spec: string }
  | { kind: "wave"; project: string; spec: string; wave: string }
  | { kind: "all_projects"; projects: string[] };

/** Stable scope kinds used by UI components for switch/match. */
export type EconomyScopeKind = EconomyScope["kind"];
```

Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/types/trace.ts
```ts
export type TraceKind =
  | "spec"
  | "wave"
  | "agent"
  | "tool"
  | "session"
  | "prompt";
```

Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/types/specs.ts
```ts
/** Lifecycle position — `Stage` in `mustard-core` (kebab-case). */
export type Stage = "analyze" | "plan" | "execute" | "qa-review" | "close";
```
